description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of different categories within a dataset, specifically showing the proportions of Math, Coding, Information Seeking, Reasoning, Planning, Creative Writing, and a combined “Others” category. The chart contains seven slices, each representing a different category. The “Math” slice is yellow and accounts for approximately 29.2% of the total, while “Coding” is blue and represents about 22.2%. “Information Seeking” is light blue and comprises 10.4%, followed by “Reasoning” in green at 2.3%. “Planning” is pink and represents 2.2%, and “Creative Writing” is purple at 2.2%. Finally, “Others (combined)” is a lighter shade of pink and accounts for 9.3% of the dataset. The chart includes a legend identifying each category and its corresponding color, and percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
